text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is an Umamusume who<n>idolizes
villains. She aspires to be a<n>"big bad" feared by all
as she casts<n>the world into terror.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While a prankster at heart, she has a<n>genuine
desire to perform well in the<n>Twinkle Series, so
she'll listen to<n>guidance when it comes to racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her greatest asset is her power, soshe's more suited to racing on dirtthan turf. This goes along with herpreference as well, since she findsdirt to be more diabolical.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can be temperamental, but her<n>talent for
running is apparent. Our first<n>step is to get her ready
to debut.
